items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: listening to Herschel... I heard some things by Coleman Hawkins... I became involved in sound... Chu Berry and, of course, Lester and Herschel... they were on the radio all the time

ctx.x: So the first pieces you had solos on, you were saying one was...was it 'Marie'?

Marie. That was Bud Freeman's solo with Tommy Dorsey's band; that was a famous solo, And then of course I did all of the Basie solos. I did Herschel's . I did Lester's solos. And the Duke Ellington things; I did Ben Webster's solos. So, I was home free, shoot. It was great to have that music in those days, so the guys could...'cause in those days all the musicians all over the country, they knew every musician in every big band; they knew what part they played; when they played a solo, they knew what their sound…
So did you finish high school?
